law_name: Law No. 1/021 of 30 December 2005 on the Protection of Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years from end of year of death (Art. 58); joint works from death of last surviving author; collective, audiovisual and posthumous works 50 years from first publication; applied art 25 years
moral_rights: Disclosure, attribution, integrity and withdrawal (Art. 22 covers name, status and integrity)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of exceptions in Art. 26, not fair use or fair dealing; Art. 26(4) allows film/TV reproduction of works permanently in public places
notes: WIPO Lex ref BI005. Berne accession 12 Jan 2016, in force 12 Apr 2016 (WIPO party list); WCT claim from Inventa article only; TRIPS from WTO membership lists; enforcement body not found

changes.from: Author's life + 50 years (inferred from Art. 58 stamp rule; general article not seen); collective, audiovisual and posthumous works 50 years from first lawful publication; applied art 25 years (Art. 61) (unconfirmed)
changes.to: Author's life + 50 years from end of year of death (Art. 58); joint works from death of last surviving author; collective, audiovisual and posthumous works 50 years from first publication; applied art 25 years
